title: Sri Lanka with FREE Excursion to Kandy
highlights: Uncover the magic of Sri Lanka, an island nation where breathtaking landscapes, ancient cultural treasures, and vibrant traditions blend seamlessly.
Step into the stunning Dambulla Cave Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and marvel at its ancient Buddhist murals with over 150 serene statues.
Marvel at the UNESCO-listed Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a marvel of ancient engineering adorned with royal gardens, the legendary frescoes, and the iconic Lion's Gate.
Visit the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery & witness the incredible journey of endangered sea turtles, from protected eggs to their release into the ocean, offering an unforgettable experience.
Discover the charm of Coconut Tree Hill, a stunning clifftop, offering breathtaking vistas of the Indian Ocean and stunning coastal landscapes.
overview:
About the Tour:
Sri Lanka is the country that has it all: jungle-covered mountains, picture-perfect beaches, delicious food, warm people, and rolling tea plantations. Plus, it’s home to some of the most extraordinary wildlife in Asia! Cross the country by train, taking in the diversity of the landscapes, and fall in love with one of our favorite countries.
Stop by the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watch the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Prepare yourself for a little challenge and conquer the 1200+ steps marked with good paths and stairs to reach the top of the Sigiriya Lion Rock. Capture glimpses of the incredible 360 degrees view over the whole area from above where every corner has its own unique view. Awaken the adventurous soul in you by indulging in a myriad of water sports for fun and thrill in Bentota from jet skiing, banana boat ride, parasailing, paramotoring, speed boat ride, yachting, canoeing, kayaking, to boating in the mangrove forests. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | En Route Visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Sigiriya
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon your arrival in Colombo, enjoy a scenic transfer to Sigiriya. En route, make a stop at the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, a renowned sanctuary dedicated to caring for orphaned elephants. Once there, witness the elephants in their natural habitat, from playful interactions to feeding and bathing sessions along the river. Continue your drive through lush landscapes, and upon reaching Sigiriya, check in to your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Sigiriya Fortress | Transfer to Kandy | En Route Visit to Dambulla Cave Temple & Old Village
days.desc: Post check-out, visit the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and climb its carved staircase to soak in panoramic views. Then, begin your journey to Kandy and, en route, visit the Dambulla Cave Temple to witness the stunning Buddhist murals. Continue to the Old Village Spice Garden to explore Sri Lanka's spices. Upon arrival in Kandy, check in to your hotel & relax. In the evening, enjoy a scenic drive around Kandy Lake, followed by a vibrant Kandyan dance performance.

items.title: Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show

days.title: Kandy Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, explore Kandy on a sightseeing tour & visit to the Market Crafts Centre, where you can purchase handmade crafts. Continue to the Gem Museum, home to a collection of Sri Lanka's semi-precious stones, & wander through the Royal Botanical Gardens, renowned for its diverse plants. Also, visit the Spice Garden to witness the world of Sri Lankan spices & marvel at the stunning orchids at the orchid house. Later, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, housing the tooth relic of Lord Buddha.

items.title: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

days.title: Transfer to Bentota | Madhu Ganga River Boat Ride | Visit to Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: After check-out, board your transfer & enjoy a scenic drive to Bentota. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel & relax. Later, get driven to Colombo Port Passenger Terminal and enjoy a serene boat ride along the Madhu Ganga River, navigating through mangrove forests & spotting vibrant wildlife. Next, visit the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, where you can learn about sea turtle conservation and witness baby turtles preparing for their journey to the ocean. After an amazing day, get driven to your hotel.

items.title: Madu Ganga Boat Safari | Balapitiya River Safari

days.title: Day Trip to Mirissa & Galle
days.desc: Today, Set off in the morning for an exciting excursion to Mirissa. Begin your journey with a visit to the UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, where the Maritime Museum brings Sri Lanka’s rich maritime history to life through captivating exhibits. Next, marvel at the stunning views of the Indian Ocean from Coconut Tree Hill & relax on the golden sands of Mirissa Beach, soaking up its stunning coastal views. Also explore the Dutch Reformed Church, a historical gem before getting driven to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to Colombo, the bustling capital of Sri Lanka. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, enjoy a sightseeing tour & visit the iconic Lotus Tower, offering panoramic views of the vibrant cityscape. Next, visit the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple & marvel at its intricate architecture. Also, stroll through the Pettah Floating Market, soaking in its lively atmosphere and colorful charm. After an amazing day, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check-out from your hotel in Colombo. Then, get driven to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your amazing Sri Lanka trip!
